newMessages.content: Task: Write a short note that explains what a password manager is.

content.text:
A password manager is a secure digital tool designed to store, manage, and generate all your online login credentials in one place. 

Instead of memorizing dozens of complex passwords or reusing the same weak one across multiple sites, you only need to remember one strong "master password" to access the vault. The manager automatically fills in your usernames and passwords when you visit websites, making your online life both safer and easier.

about.title: Evaluator loop: write, check with a word counter, improve
about.author: Agent Atlas Academy
about.description:
A writer drafts, an evaluator checks the draft against the criteria, and the writer improves it.

**What it teaches**

A loop with a clear check makes the answer better, as far as the criteria say. The evaluator counts words with a tool, because a model counts badly.

**What to watch**

What the evaluator asks to change, the number the counting tool returns, and whether round two fixes it.

Read more: [Evaluator loop](#/learn/evaluator-loop)
